title: C3b R4 Execution-Cell Performance Report
description: Evidence + typed acceptance verdict emitted by scripts/testing/perf/execution-cell-perf-harness.py, per .agents/plans/aqos-foundation-c/C3B-R4-DESIGN-AND-AUTHORIZATION.md §4/§6/§7. NON-ENFORCEMENT measurement evidence only -- this schema describes a report/receipt, never a live control-plane message.

run_id.description: Opaque correlation id for this harness invocation, shared by every JSONL row it produced.

generated_at.description: RFC3339 UTC timestamp the report was assembled.

build_revision.description: git rev-parse HEAD of the repository under measurement (design §4 host bounds).

cgroup_available.description: Whether a delegated cgroup v2 subtree was available on this host. False means cgroup-derived metrics (peak_incremental_rss_bytes) are UNAVAILABLE, never faked (design §4).

idle_baseline_bytes.description: The measured idle-runner cgroup memory.current baseline subtracted from each sample's cgroup_peak_bytes. Null iff cgroup_available is false.

revocation_under_load.description: Result of the §5 revocation-under-load mode, or null if that mode was not run in this invocation (in which case verdict.metrics_unavailable MUST include teardown_latency_p95_s -- it is never silently treated as passing).

jsonl_sha256.description: SHA-256 over the raw bytes of the JSONL evidence file -- the immutability/tamper-evidence digest named by design §4 ('a content digest').

valid.description: False iff this cohort could not prove its cache-residency bound (design §4) -- an invalid cohort always forces the overall verdict to INVALID, never PASS/FAIL.

successful_samples.description: Count of GREEN samples actually collected (target: N, default 40).

attempted_samples.description: Every attempt in this cohort, success or failure -- design §4: 'No failed/denied sample is discarded'.

sample_row.description: One line of the JSONL evidence file (design §4's frozen row schema). additionalProperties is deliberately permissive to allow future advisory-only fields (e.g. an /proc-RSS fallback) without breaking older consumers -- the REQUIRED fields below are the frozen contract.

outcome.description: 'harness-transport-error' is the harness's own typed bucket for a client<->UDS transport failure (timeout/malformed response) -- still accounted-for, never an untyped escape.

denial_code.description: Null iff outcome is 'green'. Otherwise one of R1/R2/R3's own closed typed reason/failure codes (or a 'runner-internal-error:<ExceptionName>' / 'validator:<reason>' / 'harness-transport:<detail>' composite), never an invented code.

skipped.description: Non-empty iff this host cannot exercise the real check (e.g. no delegated cgroup v2 subtree) -- R6-canary-deferred, never faked.

status.description: The typed acceptance verdict (design §4/§7). PASS iff every cohort is valid, the zero-untyped-outcome gate holds, every AVAILABLE §3 budget metric is within limit, and (when run) every §5 revocation-under-load assertion holds. An over-limit metric or an invalid cohort may never be reported as PASS.

metrics_unavailable.description: Metrics that could not be evaluated this run (e.g. no delegated cgroup for peak_incremental_rss_bytes, or revocation-under-load not invoked for teardown_latency_p95_s). Listed here, never silently folded into PASS.
